map.生成条数钳制在 1–50（缺省 5）；第 i 条默认按 i 对 6 取模循环选取: The count is clamped to 1-50 (default 5). By default the i-th entry cycles through six patterns — dots, stripes, grid, checks, diagonal, waves — by i mod 6; picking a pattern type applies it to the whole batch. The two colours c1/c2 and the cell size are random by default (colours from a 10-colour palette, size 8-64); switching Colour mode to "use main / background colour" or typing a size fixes them, so the previous result can be reproduced.
